name: 林小姐

design.prompt: Anime cel-shaded character art in the style of Studio Trigger's Cyberpunk Edgerunners: flat muted colors, bold clean black outlines, hard-edged two-tone shading, at most one small lit accent. Full body, strict side view facing right, the whole figure from the top of the head to the soles inside the frame, tall in the frame: the figure fills nine tenths of the picture height. The character stands upright and still, like a model sheet: weight evenly on both feet, hips and shoulders level, the spine vertical, the chest not pushed out and the lower back not arched, the head level. The near arm hangs straight down beside the thigh with an open empty hand; it is not swept back. The far arm is hidden behind the torso. The feet are a small step apart with the far foot half a step ahead, so the far shin and the far shoe show in front of the near leg. Miss Lin, a sales agent for a housing company, a woman of thirty, clearly a woman: about seven heads tall, slim, standing very properly with a slight apologetic tilt of the head. A soft tired face with a small polite smile, dark circles hidden under light make-up, black hair in a neat low bun with a side-swept fringe and one strand come loose. She wears a short cream-white company uniform jacket that ends at the belt line, well above the thighs, slightly too big in the shoulders, with a small teal enamel pin on the lapel; a pale blue blouse buttoned to the neck; straight dark teal trousers with a pressed crease gone soft at the knees; low black court shoes worn down at the heel; a thin gold wristwatch. Empty hands. Uneven rough hand-inked linework with varied line weight, gritty grime and fabric wrinkles where the cloth bends, slightly asymmetrical, lived-in and worn, matte not glossy, not airbrushed, no idealized perfect face. Few large plain shapes, no decorative details beyond the ones described. Even overcast light, no glow, no bloom, no text.
